snippet.title: EXODUS Extended Gameplay Reveal
snippet.description:
Step Forward. Your EXODUS begins April 7, 2027. Wishlist Now: https://exodus.game/uzc

The Extended Gameplay Reveal is the most comprehensive look at EXODUS you’ve seen yet. This is Jun Aslan’s journey across the Centauri Cluster. You’re a scrappy salvager turned Traveler pulled into the fight of your life, leading a crew of unforgettable companions across the most dangerous reaches of space, and exploring ancient ruins for what could save your homeworld from the Rot, a Celestial virus driving humanity toward extinction.

Game Director Chris King guides you through it all: combat across deadly worlds, exploration of fallen civilizations, Paladin and Immortal morality alignments that define who Jun becomes, companions—human and Awakened animal alike—who fight alongside you, and high-stakes decisions that shape how your story unfolds.

Follow EXODUS across the stars: 
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/exodusgame
X (Twitter): https://x.com/EXODUSGame 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/exodusgameofficial 
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@exodusgameofficial 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/exodusgameofficial.bsky.social 
Threads: https://www.threads.net/@exodusgameofficial 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/exodusgameofficial

Follow EXODUS regional channels:
Germany X (Twitter): https://x.com/exodusgame_de
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/exodusgame_de
France X (Twitter): https://x.com/exodusgame_fr 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/exodusgame_fr
Spain X (Twitter): https://x.com/exodusgame_es 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/exodusgame_es

EXODUS™ is a sci-fi action-adventure RPG from Wizards of the Coast and Archetype Entertainment, a studio founded by award-winning RPG veterans behind Mass Effect, Baldur's Gate, and STAR WARS: Knights of the Old Republic. Face humanity's evolution 40,000 years in the future, explore extraordinary worlds, and confront time itself to shape the fate of generations.

#EXODUSGame #FutureGamesShow #FGS #scifi #rpg
